items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: He used to come practice home, you know. Roy's home.

ctx.x: Did he play with your husband?

Oh, yeah, all of them. Buddy Petit was great, too. He was a good player. He had a funeral when he died. You know Armstrong came in, especially with him. He had a big funeral. Buddy Petit, oh, that was all... He was another fellow who drank hard, but he played. You could say he died young. And, oh, that was the boys really playing. They made money. All the boys made money. And I saw the boys in them days, I don't know, just... I think pick up that instrument. You know, they're self. They really are... I don't…
Where did you play? I said...
